short_description: Integration Flags issue for new Patientrack Process
description:
Trust identified an issue when retrospective obs are recorded on patientrack and received via integration (this is a new functionality the Trust have in Production and are looking to progress in to live in February 2026)

When these are recorded retrospectively in patient track they are shown in Symphony in a different order and not in chronological order, symphony integration fail to recognize the NEWS score is a retrospective score and change the score in the symphony tracking grid.

Example.
- Last set of obs is done at 11.00 NEWS=5
- staff record retrospective obs that were done at 10.00 with NEWS=0
- the NEWS in the Symphony tracking grid should remain 5 (as last set of observation) , instead the NEWS score changed to 'zero'.

this introduces a clinical risk:
- discrepancy on what symphony tracking grid and patientrack chart/screens is displaying ( patientrack is the single source of truth)
- risk of staff only looking at symphony and not double checking in patientrack , hence clinical decision/escalation might be missed or based on 'old' score. 

integration issue- symphony , potential high use of retrospective obs functionality  for highly acute patients (esp in RESUS) 

at the moment no existing control ( only education and comms)

short_description: Symphoney does not send document s to Viper.
description:
Dear Support, 
We have receiced the following reposrt. 
"  used to be able to access Viper 'documents' but now they don't show up or some do and some don't. It doesn't make a difference which computer I'm working from. Are you able to fix this so I can access it again please?"
I have logged toi with Viper support. They have investiaged and aske dme to log a ticket with you Seee details below from Viper support 

"Hi Arafath,
Thank you for providing the second patient example.
This confirms what we were seeing with the first example. For this patient, we can see that a document was received from Symphony for the ED attendance on 18th June, however the document was not uploaded into IMX.
On reviewing the message, it appears to contain an invalid HL7 segment at line 11, where the segment ID is simply "X" rather than a valid HL7 segment identifier. As a result, IMX is unable to process and upload the document.
Could you please raise this with Symphony using the example below for investigation? If there have been any recent changes or updates to Symphony, it would also be useful to know.
• Patient ID: 7099779729 
• Message Control ID: 2026061894561907 
• Message Date/Time: 18/06/2026 13:36:57
Please ask them to confirm whether this MDM message was sent with an "X" segment at line 11, and if so, whether this is expected behaviour. From our investigation so far, this invalid segment appears to be preventing the document from being successfully processed by IMX.
"
Thanks
Arafath
